# Chart.js

## Power-Interest-Grid

:::{#fig-powerinterestgrid}
  <canvas id="powerInterestGrid" width="540px" height="540px" style="display: block; margin: auto;"></canvas>
Power-Interest-Grid <!-- Bildunterschrift -->
:::

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>
<script>
        const ctx = document.getElementById('powerInterestGrid').getContext('2d');
        new Chart(ctx, {
            type: 'scatter',
            data: {
                datasets: [
                    { label: 'Stakeholder 1', data: [{x: 90, y: 90}], backgroundColor: 'red', pointRadius: 10 },
                    { label: 'Stakeholder 2', data: [{x: 70, y: 85}], backgroundColor: 'blue', pointRadius: 10 },
                    { label: 'Stakeholder 3', data: [{x: 80, y: 40}], backgroundColor: 'green', pointRadius: 10 },
                    { label: 'Stakeholder 4', data: [{x: 60, y: 20}], backgroundColor: 'purple', pointRadius: 10 },
                    { label: 'Stakeholder 5', data: [{x: 50, y: 50}], backgroundColor: 'orange', pointRadius: 10 },
                    { label: 'Stakeholder 6', data: [{x: 30, y: 80}], backgroundColor: 'cyan', pointRadius: 10 },
                    { label: 'Stakeholder 7', data: [{x: 20, y: 20}], backgroundColor: 'magenta', pointRadius: 10 },
                    { label: 'Stakeholder 8', data: [{x: 10, y: 90}], backgroundColor: 'yellow', pointRadius: 10 },
                    { label: 'Stakeholder 9', data: [{x: 40, y: 60}], backgroundColor: 'brown', pointRadius: 10 },
                    { label: 'Stakeholder 10', data: [{x: 75, y: 10}], backgroundColor: 'pink', pointRadius: 10 }
                ]
            },
            options: {
                scales: {
                    x: {
                        title: { display: true, text: 'Macht (Power)' },
                        min: 0, max: 100
                    },
                    y: {
                        title: { display: true, text: 'Interesse (Interest)' },
                        min: 0, max: 100
                    }
                },
                plugins: {
                    legend: {
                      display: false
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    </script>

@fig-powerinterestgrid zeigt ein einfaches Power-Interest-Grid.
